notes.title: Massive Update with Achievements - UPDATE 4.0

4 New Enemies, 3 are new types of Soldiers, and ZOMBIES!!!
Tons of code fixes/ balancing
All Bonus Rounds have been ballanced

We have a new trailer too, make sure you check out the video in the store page. :)

notes.title: Version 3.2 - Weekend Update
notes.notes:
So we are finishing up getting everything polished up, and we had some FPS bugs that we fixed.  We decided to do an update, before we update the new worlds.  Here's what we fixed.

- Polished  jumping and wall grabbing mechanics
- Speed up all worlds so they run at a faster fps ( still having issues with certain computers still running at a low fps, its an engine issue we are trying to solve)
- Polished up all stunts, getting ready for achievements.   Big worlds have 6 stunts small worlds have 3
- Fixed some of the survival rounds where the AI would stay outside the map and shoot you.
- Fixed some glitches and exploits
- Fixed MP coop volumes, where you would teleport around.
- Fixed disappearing Ai in places.
- Added  a new emoticon ːflagukraineː 


Next up will be our world update, all worlds are made and bug tested, we are fixing code, and adding a couple special things as well as figuring out an ending.  We should be ready for the new worlds in a couple weeks, just want to make sure that we provide the best we can.

notes.title: Lets Have a Great Weekend - Heres a Progress Update
notes.notes:
Lets have a great weekend everyone, here's is some news on what we have been up to.

Finally all the mapping has been completed, and we are now testing and polishing them up while the final boss gets made and the code gets finalized up.  There's a lot of polishing to do to make sure that we give the best that we can.

Whats going on with multiplayer?

Im trying to figure out a way to get a couple dedicated servers up so that we can have places for people to play who cant host. I will be also writing up a guide on how to host in multiplayer and what ports need to be opened.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=456989753] Click here for Dedicated Server Guide[/url]

We appreciate all your support with this game, and our expected release date of the new worlds will be near the end of June.

notes.title: Happy Weekend! Heres an Update on our Progress
notes.notes:
We have been working hard on the final world update, and we have also been polishing up and adding new features as well.  Its been a long haul, but we are finaly nearing the completion of the worlds.  We have been making sure that we give the best that we can give.

Some Features

We have added new weapons, so this means that also the enemies have the weapons as well.  We added a way to give certain Ai special abilities, such as more health, and a more  hostile stance.  This creates sub bosses. For example; we have Rocket Soldiers that have 4x more health and a more defensive stance that fires with a bazooka at you.

You will be able to actually kill the bosses now, by picking up the weapons and shooting at them, so that its a more immersive experience, instead of just going to the weapon and it kills the boss itself.

Whats Coming Really Soon – Expected Date : End of June

We are finishing up the bosses for the last 4 worlds, as well as doing a lot of testing to make sure that everything is balanced.  We have a new enemie type as well that is coming, however its super secret so I cant spoil anything right now.  Should make the game more interesting because the Solders also have to fight this enemie, so there is an all out war going on in the last 4 worlds.

We are getting ready for all the achievements, we are going to have about 50 total because of all the worlds and what you can do in them, so its taking us time to code them all.  They will most likely be after the world update, but they are on the list of things to be done.


We will be hosting a play with the devs event in the near future, and showing off a new map, so be on the look out for that, should be in the next couple weeks.  Im working on getting a new internet service up so it will be efficient, its taking time, but will be up soon.

We are working with a Ukrainian Group to get a language patch as well, so that we will have a Ukrainian version.  Also, if there is anyone who is able to help us translate into other versions, please get in contact with me.

Thank you all to have supported us, we are doing our best to inform, and give you our best for being our first game as a team.

Much Love

notes.title: Multiplayer Player Update - Help Test MP with us
notes.notes:
So we finally have multiplayer ready for public testing, and we have enabled the multiplayer button in the main menu.  We are allowing everyone who wants to try the multiplayer to test it out, and report back any errors in the community forums that you find  so we can get them filtered out.

We have a disclaimer in the multiplayer area, so you know what is going on with the testing.

Known Errors:

You might have to open up your ports in order to host,   we are working on that so you wont have to. 

Port to Open:  TCP 27015 (SRCDS Rcon port - For dedicated and listen servers)

notes.title: Bug Fixes / Balancing 1.1
notes.notes:
So we noticted a few bugs that were poping up that we didnt catch, so we took care of them as promptly as we could.   If you have any bugs or suggestions, we opened  a bug forums in this group.  Please post your issues there so we can organize them better, and solve them.  Before we continue on more updates, we  want to make sure all the bugs are fixed for you.

Bugs Fixed on this Update
---------------------------------------------

Fixed dying at the start of World 2

Fixed Ak's bullets, they now hit everything.

Tweeked Ak's ammo recieved at store, now recieve 50 bullets for 50 gold.

Shortened Ak's Bullet Distance, was traveling for 1/2 the map.
